I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Small technical posts get less attention, which is exactly why a focused candidate can win them.

Our archive has the 2023 PSSSB paper for Restorer and Lab Assistant (Agriculture). These posts come in small numbers inside mixed Group C advertisements. No 2027 notification has been released yet.

Will there be posts in 2027?

Posts like this appear occasionally and in small numbers. A 2027 round is possible but not confirmed. Watch every PSSSB Group C advertisement - these posts are often tucked inside them.

What we know

  • Paper: 2023 (in our archive).
  • Posts: a handful per round, inside mixed Group C advertisements.
  • Qualification: differs by post - confirm in the next notice.

How PSSSB papers work now

For its recent advertisements PSSSB uses a two-part objective paper:

PartWhatRole
Part AMatric-level PunjabiQualifying - at least 50%
Part BPost-specific paper plus GK, reasoning and related subjectsMerit list is made only from Part B
  • Part B marking: 1 mark per question, 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.
  • Standard rules: age 18-37 (up to 42 for SC/BC of Punjab, 45 for government employees); fee Rs 1,000 general, Rs 250 SC/BC/EWS, Rs 200 ex-servicemen, Rs 500 persons with disabilities. Confirm all of this in the next advertisement for this post.

How to prepare

  1. Solve the real paper: Restorer and Lab Assistant 2023 paper.
  2. 10+2 science - chemistry and biology basics, lab safety and apparatus.
  3. Agriculture basics - soils, fertilisers, seeds.
  4. GK, reasoning and Punjabi.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the PSSSB Restorer and Lab Assistant (Agriculture) exam?

A PSSSB written exam for small technical posts in the agriculture side of government. Our archive has the 2023 paper.

How many posts come?

Only a handful at a time, usually inside a larger mixed Group C advertisement.

What is the eligibility?

It differs by post - lab posts usually ask for 10+2 science or a related diploma. Read the eligibility table in the next notice instead of relying on older reports.

How is the paper set?

Recent PSSSB papers have a qualifying matric-level Punjabi Part A and a merit Part B with 1/4 negative marking. Part B mixes post-related science with GK and reasoning.

Will there be posts in 2027?

Possible in small numbers, but not confirmed. No 2027 notification has been released yet.
